retention_strategy: Bob reveals that the last player who talked to Shadow lost everything in one Trade Duel — that was him, six months ago. Dave's response is a cold smile — not fear. EP3 is mandatory.
active_loops: What is Dave actually planning? When does he go full sigma? (major)
Can Bacon Bob keep his mouth shut about the crown? (minor)
Does Bella actually like Dave, or is she fully in Rex's camp? (minor, carried from EP1)
cliffhanger: Bob reveals Shadow cost him everything six months ago. Dave smiles cold and slow — first time in the series. Cut to black.

clips.character_state: Shadow standing deep in the alcove, crown hidden inside hoodie, speaking barely above a whisper
clips.facial_expression: neutral and absolute — the certainty of someone who has held this secret for a long time, single cyan eye fixed on Dave
clips.tts: Rex's crown is a fake. This one is real. Two people knew. Now three.
clips.environment_state: Dark alcove, purple particle aura, no golden glow — crown back under hoodie
clips.action_description: Medium close-up of Shadow from slightly below — black hair half-covering his face, single cyan eye catching the dim light and holding fixed on Dave. He speaks each sentence with a pause between them. 'Now three' — delivered without emphasis, which makes it heavier. Dave barely visible at right edge of frame, completely still.

clips.character_state: Dave staring at Shadow — shock draining from his face as something colder takes its place
clips.facial_expression: expression transforming in real time — wide innocent eyes narrowing slightly, jaw setting, first visible trace of cold calculation
clips.environment_state: Dark alcove, Dave lit only by faint purple ambient from Shadow aura
clips.action_description: Close-up on Dave's face. His default-noob wide eyes begin to change — shock drains and something older settles in. Eyes drift left, barely perceptibly, toward where his inventory would be. Then back to Shadow. Two seconds of silence. Jaw firms. For the first time he does not look like a noob.

clips.character_state: Dave stands still in the alcove, focused entirely on Shadow, no nervous energy
clips.facial_expression: quiet direct intensity — jaw set, eyes calm and forward-focused, nothing like his nervous trembling from EP1
clips.tts: How long have you had it?
clips.environment_state: Dark alcove, Dave partially lit from above
clips.action_description: Medium shot of Dave facing forward and slightly upward toward the taller Shadow — Dave's full body visible from the waist up, standing still against the alcove wall. Posture different from EP1: no hunching, no fidgeting. He asks the question once. Flat. Even. No stutter. Shadow is a tall dark silhouette at the edge of frame.

clips.character_state: Shadow turns head slowly toward Dave — second sentence becomes a challenge directed straight at him
clips.facial_expression: single cyan eye narrowing with cold analytical precision — a trap wrapped in a question
clips.tts: Long enough. What are YOU hiding?
clips.environment_state: Dark alcove, Shadow's purple particles very faint
clips.action_description: Profile shot of Shadow — standing side-on, full height visible against the alcove wall, head turning slowly toward camera (Dave's POV). Visible cyan eye narrows. Delivers 'Long enough' flat. Then long beat. Then 'What are YOU hiding?' — directed at Dave like a searchlight. He does not move after.

clips.character_state: Bacon Bob shuffles into the alcove entrance from the plaza — looks up — sees Shadow and Dave — stops
clips.facial_expression: total physical freeze — dot eyes locked open, mouth gradually falling open, body completely rigid mid-shuffle
clips.environment_state: Alcove entrance, bright plaza neon blazing behind Bob, dark interior ahead with Shadow faint purple glow
clips.action_description: Wide shot from inside the alcove looking toward the entrance. Bacon Bob shuffles in from the bright plaza — shoulders slumped, head down. He looks up. Sees Shadow's glowing cyan eye in the darkness. Sees Dave's new cold stare. Bob's feet stop. Mouth opens in slow motion. He does not speak yet.

clips.character_state: Bacon Bob pressed flat against the alcove entrance wall, arms half-raised, delivering the line like a public health warning
clips.facial_expression: exhausted and resigned — dot eyes flat, downturned mouth barely moving, the face of someone recounting a trauma they have fully accepted
clips.tts: ...Shadow? Last person Rex caught talking to you lost everything in one Trade Duel. That was me. Six months ago.
clips.environment_state: Alcove entrance, Bob backlit by plaza neon, Dave and Shadow visible as silhouettes ahead in the dark
clips.action_description: Medium close-up of Bacon Bob pressed against alcove wall — backlit by plaza neon, worn scratched texture, disheveled. Delivers the line slowly, matter-of-factly, like reading from a warning sign he installed himself. Shadow does not react. Dave's face barely visible at edge of frame in the dark.
